import json, struct, numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import svd
weight_path='/workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors'
with open(weight_path,'rb') as stream:
 header_size=struct.unpack('<Q',stream.read(8))[0]
 header=json.loads(stream.read(header_size))
def read_weight(module):
 specification=header[module.replace('model.layers.','model.language_model.layers.')+'.weight']
 raw=np.memmap(weight_path, mode='r', dtype='<u2', offset=8+header_size+specification['data_offsets'][0], shape=tuple(specification['shape']))
 return (raw.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32)
first=np.load('acts/modin_8.npz')
second=np.load('acts/modin_9.npz')
for module in first.files:
 initial=first[module].reshape(8,4,-1)
 expanded=second[module].reshape(16,3,-1)
 plain=np.concatenate([initial[:,0],expanded[:,0]])
 wrong=np.concatenate([initial[:,1],expanded[:,1]])
 right=np.concatenate([initial[:,2],expanded[:,2]])
 difference=np.concatenate([wrong-plain,right-plain])
 weight=read_weight(module)
 output_difference=difference@weight.T
 plain_basis=svd(plain.T,full_matrices=False)[0]
 protected_difference=difference-(difference@plain_basis)@plain_basis.T
 output_singular=svd(output_difference,full_matrices=False)[1]
 protected_singular=svd(protected_difference,full_matrices=False)[1]
 ratios=[float(np.sum(output_singular[:rank]**2)/np.sum(output_singular**2)) for rank in (1,2,4,8)]
 print('\n',module)
 print('W norm',round(float(np.linalg.norm(weight)),3), 'input norm',round(float(np.linalg.norm(plain,axis=1).mean()),3), 'output delta',round(float(np.linalg.norm(output_difference,axis=1).mean()),3))
 print('output energy ranks1,2,4,8', [round(value,3) for value in ratios], 'mean share',round(float(np.linalg.norm(output_difference.mean(0))**2/np.mean(np.sum(output_difference**2,axis=1))),3))
 print('input novelty fraction',round(float(np.linalg.norm(protected_difference)**2/np.linalg.norm(difference)**2),3), 'protected singular',np.round(protected_singular[:12],3).tolist())
 if '.self_attn.' in module:
  head_difference=difference.reshape(48,8,256)
  head_norms=np.linalg.norm(head_difference,axis=2).mean(0)
  head_mean_norms=np.linalg.norm(head_difference.mean(0),axis=1)
  print('head differences',np.round(head_norms,3).tolist(), 'head mean differences',np.round(head_mean_norms,3).tolist())

sources=[np.load(f'acts/trace_{index}.npz') for index in (16,17,18)]

formatted_input_differences=np.concatenate([formatted_inputs[:,1]-formatted_inputs[:,0],formatted_inputs[:,2]-formatted_inputs[:,0]])
heldout_residuals=heldout['resid.15'].reshape(16,2,4,-1)
heldout_input_values=heldout['model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj'].reshape(16,2,4,-1)
heldout_residual_differences=heldout_residuals[:,1]-heldout_residuals[:,0]
plain_input_matrix=np.concatenate([input_values[:,0].reshape(96,-1),formatted_inputs[:,0].reshape(24,-1)])
plain_basis=svd(plain_input_matrix.T,full_matrices=False)[0]
generic_input_means=np.concatenate([input_differences.mean(0),formatted_input_differences.mean(0)])
generic_residual_means=np.concatenate([residual_differences.mean(0),formatted_residual_differences.mean(0)])
novelty=generic_input_means-(generic_input_means@plain_basis)@plain_basis.T
nuisance_coordinates=np.linalg.pinv(novelty.T,rcond=0.1)
for position in range(4):
 plain_signature=heldout_input_values[:,0,position]@nuisance_coordinates.T
 guess_signature=(heldout_input_values[:,1,position]-heldout_input_values[:,0,position])@nuisance_coordinates.T
 print('heldout generic coordinates',position,'plain coordinate mean/std',round(float(plain_signature[:,position].mean()),3),round(float(plain_signature[:,position].std()),3),'guess difference mean/std',round(float(guess_signature[:,position].mean()),3),round(float(guess_signature[:,position].std()),3))
paired_groups=np.concatenate([groups,groups])
residual_prototypes=[]
input_prototypes=[]
for group in range(4):
 residual_prototypes.extend(residual_differences[paired_groups==group].mean(0))
 input_prototypes.extend(input_differences[paired_groups==group].mean(0))
for group in range(3):

 residual_prototypes.extend(formatted_residual_differences[selection].mean(0))

 print(label,'prototype singular values',np.round(svd(prototypes,full_matrices=False)[1][:12],3).tolist())

print('prototype novelty energy fraction',float(np.linalg.norm(novel_prototypes)**2/np.linalg.norm(prototype_inputs)**2))
generic_protected=novel_prototypes[:7]
